blocks.text: NEW YORK — Authorities are investigating why a small plane carrying six members of a Florida family crashed off the Mississippi coast on Tuesday. They were returning home from a fishing trip, relatives say. The plane’s pilot was Brent Stokes, the 50-year-old president of a marine contracting company based in Fort Myers, according to Jackson County Coroner Bruce Lynd Jr. Stokes’ company’s website described him as an “avid fisherman and life time boater.” The other victims were Stokes’ 16-year-old son, Hunter Stokes; Stokes’ sister, Arlyn Knox, 43; her husband, Michael Knox, 43; and their two sons, 12-year-old Charles Holden Knox and […]...
